in_sanskrit.name: जीतान्तक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who conquers in battle or in life's challenges

in_hindi.name: जीतान्त्शी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Geeta (Geeta is a common name for girls in India, derived from the name of the epic Mahabharata's character Geeta) + antsh (suffix meaning 'belonging to' or 'possessing') + ki (diminutive suffix) = Geetanshi, a name meaning 'belonging to Geeta' or 'possessing the qualities of Geeta'

in_tamil.name: ஜீதாந்த்சி

in_telugu.name: జీతధేశి
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who possesses victory or triumph

in_marathi.name: Geetanshi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geetanshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geetanshi is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘geeta’ which means song and ‘ansh’ which means essence or soul. The name signifies the melody of the soul.
